t: A free speech-to-text app that runs entirely on the user's computer.
steps: Find the Murmure releases page from the project site.
Ask IT to approve the install.
Download the installer for your system, such as an MSI, a dmg, or a Linux package.
Install the VC++ redistributable on Windows if the app asks for it.
Stay online for the first setup, then test dictation offline.
Leave the optional connection to an outside LLM server turned off.
Try dictation in a word processor with a short sentence.
